name: ModeScope
summary: Sets data-mode='restrained' | 'expressive' on a container so descendants resolve mode-aware semantic tokens. The single source-of-truth for switching Lumen modes. Components are mode-agnostic; semantic surface / atmosphere / motion tokens rebind under the scope.

mode.description: The Lumen mode applied to descendants. Restrained for dense operator surfaces (dashboards, tables, settings, terminals, command palette); expressive for landing surfaces, marketing, AI surfaces, onboarding, empty states, hero panels.

as.description: HTML element used as the scope container.

wcag: 1.4.1 Use of Color — atmospheric overlays never carry meaning (decorative only).
1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus — glass surfaces inside scope honor the master backdrop-filter policy.
2.3.3 Animation from Interactions — mesh-drift animation gates on prefers-reduced-motion.
1.4.10 Reflow — mode does not affect layout reflow; mode rebinds only surface and motion tokens.
rules: ModeScope itself is a semantic-neutral container — no aria attributes needed; the data-mode attribute is for CSS variable scoping, not assistive tech.
Mesh + grain + aurora animations gate on prefers-reduced-motion via @media in dist/css/lumen.scoping.css.
Glass blur + atmospheric overlays gate on prefers-reduced-transparency via @media in dist/css/lumen.scoping.css.

do: Wrap landing / marketing / AI / onboarding / empty-state / hero panels in <ModeScope mode='expressive'>.
Default to restrained — explicit mode prop optional; omitting it leaves descendants on restrained tokens.
Use as='section' or as='main' for semantic html when wrapping a page-level region.
Compose at the largest scope where mode applies — one ModeScope per page section, not per component.
dont: NEVER nest a ModeScope of opposite mode inside another ModeScope. Mode-mixing on the same page invites contrast bugs and is undefined behavior.
NEVER pass mode as a prop to any individual component. Mode is a scope attribute; components do not branch on mode.
NEVER apply data-mode directly to a primitive element. Use ModeScope so the attribute is paired with the right React semantics and the CSS scoping has a known anchor.
NEVER use expressive mode on a data table, row, cell, chart axis, or any surface where atmospheric overlay would reduce text contrast.
NEVER assume mode controls layout — it does not. Mode only rebinds surface / atmosphere / motion tokens.

changelog.note: v0.13 Phase 1 initial release. The mode-switch primitive — sets data-mode on a container so descendants resolve mode-aware semantic tokens.
